_about: Chess backgrounds, boards and piece sets (docs/CHESS-LOOK-PLAN.md). Paint: python scripts/game_art.py chess paint ~/dragon-art-inbox/chess. bg/volcano, bg/underwater and bg/space are painted and tidied with --style b: style a's words about no chessboard made the painter put a chessboard on the ground.

styles.a: Hand-painted fantasy storybook game background, rich glowing colours, soft painterly light, magical and inviting, detailed edges with a calm uncluttered middle, friendly for children aged 8 to 11, no people, no chess pieces, no chessboard, no writing, no letters, no numbers, no labels anywhere.
styles.b: Hand-painted fantasy storybook game background, rich glowing colours, soft painterly light, magical and inviting, detailed edges with a calm uncluttered middle, friendly for children aged 8 to 11, no people, no writing, no letters, no numbers anywhere.

pictures.name: bg/castle
pictures.prompt: The inside of a grand royal castle great hall seen straight on from the middle of the room, tall stone arches and pillars on both sides, huge stained-glass windows glowing gold and blue, red and gold banners hanging from the walls, flickering torches and candle chandeliers, a polished stone floor stretching back to a big throne on a raised step far away in the distance, warm golden light pouring down the centre, soft floating dust motes, the middle of the picture open and calm, wide landscape.

pictures.name: bg/forest
pictures.prompt: A sunlit magical forest clearing seen from inside the trees, giant old mossy trees framing both sides, ferns and glowing mushrooms along the edges, shafts of golden light falling through the green leafy canopy, a soft grassy clearing stretching back to misty trees in the distance, a few drifting leaves, the middle of the picture open and calm, wide landscape.

pictures.name: bg/coast
pictures.prompt: A wild New Zealand Wairarapa coastline at sunset, a long sweep of grey sand beach and rocky shore platform, tall pointed rock pinnacles and a white lighthouse on a far headland, golden orange and pink sunset sky over the calm sea, waves rolling in with sea spray, flax bushes and pōhutukawa trees on the edges, the middle of the picture open and calm, wide landscape.

pictures.name: bg/volcano
pictures.prompt: A dramatic volcano landscape at dusk seen from a high rocky cliff top, a huge smoking volcano far away across a wide valley with glowing orange lava rivers running down its sides and winding through the valley below, jagged black rocks and glowing cracks framing the left and right edges, a deep red and purple sky with drifting embers and sparks, exciting but not scary, the middle of the picture open sky and distant valley, calm, wide landscape.

pictures.name: bg/snow
pictures.prompt: A snowy mountain top above the clouds, sparkling white snow peaks all around, a sea of soft clouds far below, a clear deep blue sky with the first evening stars, snow-covered pine trees and ice crystals at the edges, gentle snowflakes falling, crisp cold sunlight, the middle of the picture open and calm, wide landscape.

pictures.name: bg/underwater
pictures.prompt: A magical underwater palace seen while swimming in the open blue water, tall coral towers and pearl-white arches on both sides, colourful coral reefs, sea anemones and swaying kelp along the edges, schools of small bright fish in the distance, beams of blue-green sunlight shining down from the water surface, rising bubbles, the sea floor soft white sand with shells, the middle of the picture open blue water, calm, wide landscape.

pictures.name: bg/space
pictures.prompt: Floating in space beside a futuristic white space station, its curved panels, glowing blue lights and solar wings framing the left and right edges, a big glowing ringed planet and a colourful swirling nebula full of stars beyond, a small blue Earth-like planet far away, the middle of the picture open starry space, calm and wondrous, wide landscape.
